title: Claude Plugins Official

discoveries.finding: Discord plugin exposes 5 MCP tools (reply, react, edit_message, fetch_messages, download_attachment) for bidirectional agent-to-human messaging. Pairing flow + allowlist access control. Bun + TypeScript MCP server.
discoveries.use_case: Install for remote overnight agent monitoring and control from phone

discoveries.finding: Telegram plugin exposes 3 MCP tools (reply, react, edit_message). More limited than Discord (no fetch_messages, no historical attachments). Photos auto-downloaded on arrival.
discoveries.use_case: Secondary alert channel for critical agent events (crashes, PR failures)

discoveries.finding: Claude Code --channels flag enables messaging platform integration. Channel plugins register as MCP servers and forward inbound messages as channel events. Multiple instances via STATE_DIR env vars.
discoveries.use_case: Core mechanism for remote agent control — one bot per orchestrator session

discoveries.finding: Official Claude Code plugin format: plugin.json (metadata) + .mcp.json (MCP config) + commands/ + agents/ + skills/. 32 internal + 15 external plugins. Install via /plugin install or GUI discovery.
discoveries.use_case: Build custom orchestration plugin exposing tmux session management as MCP tools

discoveries.finding: 12 LSP integrations (TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, C#, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, PHP, Lua, Swift, C/C++) as official plugins. Agents can opt into language server features.
discoveries.use_case: Reference only — agents handle their own tooling

key_takeaway: Discord plugin is the immediate win for remote agent monitoring/control. Install today with --channels flag for overnight autonomous operations. Telegram as secondary alert channel. Plugin system structure is the canonical Claude Code extensibility model.
